title: Real-SWAP local corrector response inside empirically admitted F-GC45 head band
measurements: real q_swap for both tiles and area-weighted q at every fixed head
central corrector finite-difference slopes using +/-0.25 and +/-0.5 live-shift scale
production affine slope u/dt from the unchanged predictor response
ratio and difference between corrector FD slope and production affine slope
production affine q and corrector q at the center
existing F-GC45 live coupled result and committed tile ledgers
gates: all five fixed-head real SWAP trials are accepted whole-window trials
all probes are discarded back to the immutable origin
area weighting closes at every probe
FD slopes are finite; no preregistered equality to production u/dt is required
the unchanged F-GC45 live coupling converges
committed ledgers equal integrated accepted corrector flux per tile within 1e-12 m
decision_rules: If corrector slope approximately matches production affine slope, classify this only as local tangent agreement, not proof that u is physical storage.
If slopes differ, classify whether the mismatch is intercept/nonlinearity/numerical-resolution before any production conclusion.
The accepted ledger remains physical whole-window exchange authority.
